target_customer: Hedge funds, systematic traders and institutional investors
problem: Investment research runs across siloed systems and slow workflows, so finding, testing and validating trading signals is limited by human team capacity.
business_model: B2B software and signals for funds (pricing not public)
product_category: AI quant research agents for finance

founders.name: Jeremie Cohen
founders.background_notes: YC page says he managed a large global systematic equity book at WorldQuant for six years, led a machine learning team at Millennium, and did data engineering at SolveBio; it calls him a nuclear engineer by training without naming a school.

competitors.name: Pinegap
competitors.what: Custom AI research agents for institutional investors
competitors.traction_then: Company reported over 1,000 agents deployed across more than 100 institutional clients

competitors.name: AgentSmyth
competitors.what: Autonomous agent platform for trading and investment intelligence

technical_complexity.rationale: Autonomously generating and validating trading signals without overfitting needs quant research depth plus agent engineering, and results must hold up on live data.

defensibility.rationale: Differentiation rests on founder quant credibility and live signal track record; several funded rivals pursue the same idea and signals can decay.

incumbents: Large quant funds building in house
takeover_risk_then.outcome: Not observed yet; funded startups such as Pinegap and AgentSmyth were already selling to institutions.

market_need_then: Funds have more data and compute than before but research workflows stay fragmented, and AI agents for institutional research were attracting seed and Series A funding in 2026.

branding.domain_note: Uses kelaitech.com, not an exact kelai.com match; acquisition history not found.

identity.voice_and_tone: Concise, research driven, measured; messaging such as 'Building trust in financial AI.'

brand_strength.rationale: No press on the brand itself; the AI suffix is common among AI names and the .com variant is not used.

outcome_analysis: KelAI is a Spring 2026 company that announced a $5M seed in July 2026 led by Frst, Y Combinator and Robinhood Ventures, with signals reportedly live at an institutional investor since October 2025. The founder's WorldQuant and Millennium background fits the buyers. No exit or distress was found, and rivals such as Pinegap, AgentSmyth and Itoflow (pre-seed, August 2026) are raising in the same space.
notes: The $5M seed is reported by fintech.global, AlleyWatch and Hedgeweek. PitchBook lists a total of $5.47M and Signalbase reported $15M; the $15M figure is unverified and conflicts with the others. Competitor source dates for Pinegap and AgentSmyth were not confirmed, so source_date is null; they are listed because they were selling to institutions by the batch period per 2026 coverage. Company says founding year 2025 (YC page and PitchBook).
